title: El Hombre Mediocre: Ensayo de psicologia y moral
summary: "El Hombre Mediocre: Ensayo de psicologia y moral" by José Ingenieros is a philosophical essay published in 1913. This work examines human nature by categorizing people into three types: the inferior man, the mediocre man, and the superior idealist. Ingenieros contrasts those who blindly follow routine and tradition with visionaries who use imagination to pursue higher ideals.
